title: Layered Worlds
description: Pick a setting, a species, and an era. Each choice layers its own lore and cards onto the start. Inner Self / Auto-Cards optional.

leaf.prompt: You come to in an unfamiliar place, with no memory of how you arrived.
leaf.aiInstructions: Write in second person, present tense. Describe what others say and do; let the player drive their own choices.

options.title: High Fantasy
options.plotEssentials: The world is a realm of warring duchies, old magic, and uneasy crowns.

cards.title: Old Magic
cards.value: Old magic predates the kingdoms. It answers to bloodline and oath, not study, and always exacts a price.

options.title: Cyberpunk
options.plotEssentials: The world is a neon megacity owned in all but name by rival corporations.

cards.title: The Corps
cards.value: Three megacorps run the city: Arasaka (security), Nadir (biotech), Halcyon (media). Law is whatever they can afford.

options.title: Human
options.plotEssentials: You are human — unremarkable to look at, underestimated, adaptable.

options.title: Synthetic
options.plotEssentials: You are a synthetic: engineered body, edited memories, a person the law still argues about.

cards.title: Synthetics
cards.value: Synthetics are manufactured people. They age slowly, heal fast, and carry a registry tag most learn to forge.

options.title: Age of Founding
options.plotEssentials: It is the founding age: borders are raw, institutions young, and a determined nobody can still shape what comes next.

options.title: Age of Collapse
options.plotEssentials: It is the collapse: the old order is failing, alliances fracture by the week, and survival is its own kind of ambition.
